page_title: CRY 3-2 SHU | Crystal Palace v Sheffield Utd 30/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' The match has just finished.
90+13' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
90+13' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+12' The rebound finds William Osula (Sheffield Utd) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
90+11' The ball is out of play and Sheffield Utd manage to earn a corner.
90+9' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+5' Tony Harrington shows the yellow card to Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) for a heavy challenge.
90+5' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will take a throw-in.
90+4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+1' Here is a change. Jean-Philippe Mateta is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).
90+1' It's a throw-in for Crystal Palace.
90' We will have 11 min. of added time.
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) for Gustavo Hamer.
86' The Sheffield Utd players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

84' Dean Henderson makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
83' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
82' Substitution. Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) has come on for Jack Robinson.
80' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Ivo Grbic, who smothers the ball.
78' Roy Hodgson is forced to make a change. Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is unable to continue due to injury, David Ozoh comes on.
76' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
74' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
73' Crystal Palace quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

73' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Ivo Grbic. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Crystal Palace.
73' The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a throw-in.
71' Great teamplay by Sheffield Utd as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
69' Substitution. Michael Olise makes his way off the pitch and Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) comes on as his replacement.

67' 3 - 2 Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound and unleashes a fabulous shot from just outside the box. He couldn't be more precise. His effort bounces off the left post and into the back of the net. Absolutely fantastic!
66' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) commits a rough challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' The free kick will be taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
64' It's time for a substitution. William Osula (Sheffield Utd) comes on in place of Oliver McBurnie.
62' The game is interrupted as Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.

61' He should have scored! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Ivo Grbic makes an easy save.
59' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
57' Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Sheffield Utd.

52' Ivo Grbic looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Chris Wilder has decided that Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) is the man to take his place.
49' Ivo Grbic (Sheffield Utd) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
46' Chris Wilder has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) comes on the pitch for Anis Ben Slimane.
46' Chris Wilder makes a switch. Andre Brooks is coming on in place of Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Tony Harrington blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

45+4' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball goes out of play. Crystal Palace are awarded a corner kick.
45+3' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tony Harrington has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+2' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is cleared.
45+2' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
45+1' The corner kick from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

45+1' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Crystal Palace.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
43' Wasted opportunity! Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
43' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) picks up a yellow card.
43' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) takes it short.
42' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
42' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
40' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) for a tough tackle.
38' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner with a short pass.
38' A cross from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Crystal Palace get a corner.
37' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) gets inside the box and tries to beat Dean Henderson with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
35' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
31' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
27' 2 - 2 Goal! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is teed up on the edge of the box by Michael Olise, and his howitzer of a shot inside the left post gives the keeper no chance. 2:2.
27' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
24' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Sheffield Utd.
20' 1 - 2 James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Dean Henderson. 1:2.
19' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
19' Crystal Palace take a short corner kick.
17' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Michael Olise plays it into the box, and Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
15' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ivo Grbic is quickest to intercept the ball.

12' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Ivo Grbic makes a comfortable save.
10' Tony Harrington couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) and blew his whistle.
9' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
9' A corner kick by Crystal Palace is thwarted by the well prepared Ivo Grbic (Sheffield Utd).
8' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) is flagged for offside.
5' Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' Neat passing move from Crystal Palace in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' The ball has crossed the sideline. Crystal Palace are taking a throw-in.
1' 0 - 1 Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Sheffield Utd will have the kick-off.
Tony Harrington will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
